validation_scope: All 48 images decode at fixed dimensions; archived backgrounds render through actual backdrop compositor using explicit overrides. Serialized data strings, actual animation graph names and autotile declarations are audited; no map event command is executed. Static/raw-byte code scan and decoded-pixel duplicate audit are separate evidence. Explicit archive rendering is not ordinary map selection, complete gameplay, move playback or autotile-seam certification.
limits: No proof of ordinary archive selection, full gameplay, Android device behavior or autotile seams. Seven non-Marshal/legacy-class data files were covered by raw-byte scan rather than generic deserialization. Localized catalogs were raw-scanned; animation names use the actual API.
